originalRequirements: Platform 10.1.x+ is required by the Agent Mode feature guide.

The feature guide describes a Cloud Connected SAIA 2.1+ path, but current installation guidance says 2.2.0–2.3.6 lacks Cloud Connected and its 2.1.1 fallback lacks Agent Mode; SAIA-9918 independently records the access issue.
Model Runtime must be enabled; a Splunk-hosted-only setting does not satisfy the documented Agent Mode runtime choice.
Cloud Connected setup also requires the documented bidirectional connectivity, regional allowlist and certificate/stack-address configuration.
The documented limited IL2 FedRAMP assistant excludes Agent Mode.
Cloud Connected support is planned for SAIA 2.4.0 in late November 2026; a plan does not establish a released supported path.
